ux_finding.title: Plain-language contextual tooltips across economic systems
requirements: Use user-facing label Gold-bearing rock (quartz) instead of unexplained quartz-bearing rock
One-sentence everyday description on hover/tap for unfamiliar terms
Optional expandable details with historical/technical terminology
Clearly distinguish possible gold-bearing material from tested ore, contained gold, recovered gold and sold gold
Apply similarly to mineral claims, mortgage liens, loans, assay, freight, labor and property title
Tooltips are educational, not evidence of discovered/hidden material quality

additional_findings: VEIN-VALID-018: Accepted conditional ore purchase still requires inspection, actual payment and separate lot removal
VEIN-CAL-013: Four-to-six miner wage rate per week overwhelms small parcel ore receipts; expansion needs real recovery throughput/capital
VEIN-DES-010: Delegation must pause safely at cash reserves while preserving NPC agency and possible employee attrition
next_decision: Owner must accept or reject financing term sheets or explicitly release protected cash reserve. Continue title search; no land purchase and no mill construction authorized. Mine full-crew extraction paused pending feasible funding; owners retain sales and hiring decisions.
